Freedom Domain

Cleric Subclass

Clerics of the domain of Freedom follow their God’s will of freeing people from their shackles. They are liberators from cruel lords, emancipators of those in slave labor, and also freers from more abstract chains. The sight of a Freedom Cleric is one that brings hope to the downtrodden and fear to the oppressor.

Cleric Level Features
1st Liberating Touch
2nd Channel Divinity: Freedom’s Grace
6th Sever the Chains
8th Divine Strike
17th Avatar of Emancipation

Freedom Domain Spells

Cleric Level Spells
1st Expeditious Retreat, Longstrider
3rd Blur, Pass Without Trace
5th Fly, Nondetection
7th Aura of Purity, Freedom of Movement
9th Control Winds, Passwall

Liberating Touch

Starting at 1st level, you can channel your god’s will to break the chains of those around you. As a bonus action, you can end the Charmed, Paralyzed, Restrained, or Stunned condition on a creature within 15 ft. of you. They may then use their reaction to move up to 15 ft. without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

You can use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

Channel Divinity: Freedom’s Grace

Starting at 2nd level, you can use your Channel Divinity to imbue the feeling of freedom to your allies. As an action, choose a number of creatures within 30 ft. of you equal to your proficiency bonus, all of them gain additional 10 ft. of movement, creatures have disadvantage on opportunity attacks against them, and they have advantage against the Grappled, Charmed, Paralyzed, Restrained, and Stunned conditions.

Sever the Chains

At 6th level, your divine magic can aid your allies to free them of their binds. When you cast a spell on a creature that would make a saving throw at the start or end of their turn to end an effect, you may expend a use of Liberating Touch to allow them to roll that saving throw as a reaction.

Divine Strike

At 8th level, you gain the ability to infuse your weapon strikes with psychic energy. Once on each of your turns when you hit a creature with a weapon attack, you can cause the attack to deal an extra 1d8 psychic damage to the target. When you reach 14th level, the extra damage increases to 2d8.

Avatar of Emancipation

Starting at 17th level, you have become one with the domain of Freedom. All creatures under your Freedom’s Grace are now immune to the Grappled, Charmed, Incapacitated, Paralyzed, Petrified, Prone, Restrained, and Stunned conditions.
